theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_lc_rc_measure_le_add_of_closed
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (V F : Set (Euclid P)) (X X₁ X₂ : GeometricCurrentOn V n) (R R₁ R₂ : IMRep V n), IsOpen V → R.Represents X → R₁.Represents X₁ → R₂.Represents X₂ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn V n, X ω = X₁ ω + X₂ ω) → IsClosed F → F ⊆ V → R.measure F ≤ R₁.measure F + R₂.measure F
